name: agent-ios-swiftui
description: Rules, reviewers and checks for SwiftUI iOS apps in Claude Code, on top of agent-core: an app target of views over one Swift package of tested logic, a generated API client, String Catalogs. Hook: generated-guard refuses hand edits to the generated API client and the copied OpenAPI spec (paths in .claude/agent-config.json). Commands: setup and sync install and verify the iOS rules, anti-patterns, gate scripts (SwiftLint suppressions, Xcode settings, package graph, String Catalogs, error codes, privacy manifest, per-file coverage), SwiftLint, swift-format and xcconfig settings, a seeded RFC 9457 problem type with its tests, a pre-commit hook and a pull-request-only CI caller; a11y-audit runs the accessibility audit UI tests on a simulator. Agents: reviewer and i18n-guard. Skills: swiftui-screen and openapi-client-update. Nothing signs a build or touches a provisioning profile. The hook runs on your machine, opens no network connection and stays silent until the project opts in.
